text: Can you make a thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better? This is a habit I've struggled with myself, so the topic feels pretty personal to me. I mean one 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, and I'd like you to choose a punchy headline that's exactly three words in English. Please invent a tired-looking person for it, with their age, appearance and placement up to you, but make the face big. I'm a little worried about it getting lost among all the other thumbnails people see. Make it easy to read on a phone; the style, colours and layout are your call, and free-tier resolution is fine.
